epigraph.quote: I am more skeptical of my own beliefs than anyone will ever be to my own.

note.body: The piece carries its own warning: people in heightened states mistake a new belief for a new identity. It names spiritual psychosis as a failure mode of the very experiences it describes.

body: …or relating to imagination.
For now it will just be very general ideas because there's a lot to unpack. But bear with me, it will get much more elaborate as you continue.
▶ In quantum physics, there has been continuing & increasing evidence that everything is made of energy.
**Everything is energy.**
**Everything is made of vibration (energy) or waves.**

fragments.title: Sound / Waves
body: can be seen as ~~simple~~ a ripple of bends in space.
This is incredibly difficult to explain or imagine. So I will use sound as an analogy.
Even with just a little understanding of physics, we know that sound is a constant collision of particles, or a wave.
~~Sound itself is not something material, but is~~
Sound and other waves that we experience everyday are more "mechanical" than the waves we are referring to when talking about…
…energy.
Mechanical in the sense that it consists of definitive working parts that are much easier to imagine.
Waves ~~and vibration~~ can be seen anywhere.
Dominoes repeatedly falling one after the other can be used to depict the way sound travels through a medium.
So, ~~we~~ sound (waves) are not ~~our~~ a material thing but instead are the ~~medium or~~ pattern we see in interactions / relationships of mediums.

fragments.title: Energy of Reality
body: Anyways, everything is composed of vibration & energy.
Everything you are experiencing or reality is simply the warping or incredibly fast vibration of the "fabric" of reality, or space, or space-time.

Ancient religions seem to have known this. I learned from an external source (rather than internal) that ancient religions & modern religions say the universe is a song, or that it was sung into existence. Or spoken into existence. Christianity talks about the WORD of God (spoken).
I learned this & many other things by exploring internally.
Uni-verse. One song.
The universe is a fabric that is constantly vibrating (energy), and to us observers we experience the illusion of it being material.
~~Back to quantum physics if—~~ ~~since this universe is a field of "fabric" that is warped in a vibrating way~~ ~~since everything has a vibration & can be tuned—~~
**We can control reality (9)**
**reality can be manipulated (10)**
~~let's assume that because all things have a vibration / vibrate at certain ranges of frequencies, they can also act as waves and have a resonance.~~
Our brains may have the ability to produce specific types of vibrational, ~~electromagnetic patterns~~ quantum patterns.
If we assume that the waves that compose the vibrations have an ~~predisposition~~ *inclination* of aligning with each other, then that can explain…
…manifestation.
Also going back to why vibration and frequency create the illusion of material.
Let's imagine there is a laser pointer. If you begin to ~~spin the~~ point the laser in a circular motion, eventually it will create the illusion of a circle.
**This is what reality is. A projection & interpretation of vibrating fabric (speed of light).**

body: To be clear, assuming that the laser analogy is a good example of how the illusion of material is created, it is important to understand that even though the circle itself is composed of a "mechanical" dot (laser), the universe is not composed of anything mechanical.
✱ (To make the analogy cooler, we can say that the laser itself is made of light or electromagnetic waves. So even that isn't mechanical.)
The point is, the universe ~~isn't~~ *(not exclusively)* a matrix of small particles moving at light speed to create the illusion of the everyday world we observe. But instead,
…is a complex matrix of vibrating "fabric" that creates the illusion of things like particles or atoms and the everyday world we observe.
It's not mechanical, it's ~~musical~~ **musical** or vibrational — it's a complex space-time fabric.
We will get into time and 4-D concepts eventually.
So, why does the universe being a vibrational matrix matter to you? Because it shows that everything is interwoven with…
…or can be influenced by everything else.

Just like the push of the first domino in a line of infinitely many dominos. except the domino example is a 1-dimensional matrix. Think about how vastly complex it is with the 3D world we experience. And with the other dimensions that we don't experience, ~~oth~~ 4-D, 5-D… all the way until the ultimate and absolute source or GOD.
GallD ~~[struck — illegible]~~
So, the universe is constantly influencing itself in parts.
**We can influence our reality with our minds (9).**
To get straight to the point, the brain ~~as~~ can be described as technology.

The brain seems to be able to produce quantum waves that can be described as a 'reality mold' or 'quantum mold'. and since reality is composed of waves it can naturally resonate and align with the mold. (manifestation in relation to our brain).
✱ What is this quantum wave/mold? ~~[struck — illegible]~~ I'm not sure. but my best ~~gu—~~ guess.

body: We are not (Ultimately) the collaboration of neurons forming a sentient, conscious - awareness. **(7)**

i used to struggle ~~[struck]~~ with certain truths, and it would really drain me of meaning and always place me *into* ~~into~~ a state of existential awareness or dread.
A truth being, that since i am the creator of this reality, it is possible…
